proposals.title: Shareholder proposal regarding political contributions disclosure
proposals.proponent: Mercy A. Rome, c/o Newground Social Investment
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semiannually updated report disclosing political campaign and public-influence contribution policies, recipients, amounts, and responsible NIKE decision-makers, including trade association and 501(c)(4) payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the Proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response
